backlogged.summary: lib/commands/run.mjs now reads HARNESS_TEST_SLEEP_OFFSET_FILE from the environment in production code to shift the sleep detector's wall clock. It is a no-op when unset, but a stray value in a user's environment would make the detector see fake system sleep. Consider a more clearly namespaced or guarded seam.

The F52 AC-1 test checks exit 1 and the stderr text, but nothing asserts the criterion's second clause (test/f21-sleep.test.mjs does not read lib/commands/run.mjs). That clause holds today because only a comment mentions the file; a grep assertion would stop it coming back.
lib/stress.mjs is a support module used only by test/stress.mjs (the stderr tail helper), yet it ships under lib/. A test-support location may fit better.
